---
name: Ask GPT-2 anything
about: GPT-2 small (124M) runs from a Markdown document via a GitHub Action
title: "gpt2: "
---

Put the start of any text in the **title** after `gpt2:`, then Submit. A bot runs GPT-2 from `mdrt/GPT2.md`, replies with the continuation and an animation (about 2 to 5 minutes), and closes this issue. Leave this body as is.
